import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    if n == 0:
        print()
        return
    arr = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    arr.sort()
    sys.stdout.write(' '.join(map(str, arr)) + ' ')

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
